content: Extend the W0112 cdev worker binding with an optional caller-owned retain/release reference for the direct backend memory handle, retaining it through asynchronous completion and ring backpressure without changing mf_backend_api_v1 or the Linux UAPI.

Committed direct backend-memory reference retention as b03c4f3. The cdev worker validates empty-or-complete callbacks, retains the direct payload handle before COPY, snapshots it with pending backend binding, and releases it after synchronous completion or asynchronous completion, cancellation, and backpressure. Focused cdev/component tests passed 2/2; full development CTest passed 84/84; git diff --check passed. Agent Harness (codex) is both commit author and committer.
